nodes.notes: After importing the main workflow, open this node and select the imported Jina Reader - Fetch URL workflow.

parameters.content:
## Test workflow setup

1. Import `jina-reader-fetch-url.workflow.json`.
2. Import this test workflow.
3. Open **Call Jina Reader Workflow** and select the imported main workflow.
4. Run manually.

This test sends two items:
- `https://serper.dev/`
- `//docs.n8n.io/connect/create-nodes/overview`

Expected: each item returns `status: ok`, `provider: jina_reader`, `fetched: true`.
